name: Shimokita Hanto Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Shimokita Peninsula: the Osorezan holy caldera, the Hotokegaura sea cliffs and the cape forests of Japan's northern tip.
notes: Managed by Aomori. Osorezan's memorial temple is the peninsula's famous pilgrimage.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
